rationale: Four prior eras closed NO-GO. Mechanism-v4 produced the project's first real positive (within-parent absolute localization, auROC 0.9503) but failed because the signal was bulk composition and did not transfer across genes, with rich features transferring WORSE than composition. v5 acts on that specific evidence: it tests edit direction where real parent breadth exists, and it deliberately uses LOW-capacity representations because high capacity was measured to hurt transfer.

diagnostics_that_shaped_this_design.note: Measurement-only. No model score was produced before this file was committed.
diagnostics_that_shaped_this_design.refuted_hypothesis: I predicted v4's cross-gene failure was driven by gene baseline offsets. Mikl between-gene variance is only 2.0 percent, so that hypothesis is REFUTED and gene-centering is not used as the fix.
diagnostics_that_shaped_this_design.pooling_rejected_because: The pooled confident set is 24328 rows of which 22986 (94 percent) are Moffatt's 10 genes at positive rate 0.778, against Mikl's 1342 rows at 0.251. Pooling would be dominated by one source with an incompatible label distribution, so the sources are kept separate.
diagnostics_that_shaped_this_design.length_consequence: Because sequence length differs across sources, every feature in v5 is a k-mer FREQUENCY, never a raw count as in v4.

A_cross_gene_edit_direction.question: With real parent breadth, can the DIRECTION of an edit's effect on localization be predicted for sequences from entirely unseen genes?
A_cross_gene_edit_direction.why_new: Mechanism-v2 tested paired ranking within decision sets (reliability 0.239). Mechanism-v4 tested transfer on only 10 genes. Nothing has yet tested edit direction across 166 genes with grouped folds and composition controls.
A_cross_gene_edit_direction.label: sign of localization_effect, restricted to confident sequences with |effect / effect_uncertainty| >= 1.96; 1 means shift toward neurite
A_cross_gene_edit_direction.split: frozen biological_fold, grouped so no gene or group_id straddles train and test
A_cross_gene_edit_direction.fold_balance_note: Unlike Moffatt in v4 (0.077 to 0.859), Mikl fold positive rates span only 0.211 to 0.286, so cross-fold auROC is interpretable here.
A_cross_gene_edit_direction.features: DELTA k-mer frequencies, mutant minus parent, k in [1,2,3], 84 columns
A_cross_gene_edit_direction.capacity_justification: v4 measured that 1364 features transferred 0.055 auROC WORSE across genes than 20 composition features. Low capacity is therefore a pre-registered prediction, not a convenience.

B_cross_source_finite_difference.question: Does an absolute-localization model trained on the high-reliability source predict edit effects in a different source, assay and cell type, by finite difference?
B_cross_source_finite_difference.why_new: This is the RNAddress construction itself and has never been run. Mechanism-v2 used frozen mechanism features, not a supervised absolute-localization model applied as f(mutant) - f(parent). It trains where reliability is 0.88 and tests where breadth is 166 genes.
B_cross_source_finite_difference.features: k-mer FREQUENCIES, k in [1,2,3], 84 columns, length-invariant so a 260 nt training source can score 150 nt test sequences
B_cross_source_finite_difference.zero_shot: no test-source outcome is ever used for fitting or tuning
B_cross_source_finite_difference.mechanistic_basis: Mendonsa et al. report that mutations ADDING (AU) or (UA) repeats induce neurite localization, so a composition-sensitive absolute model has a real reason to carry edit-direction information.
B_cross_source_finite_difference.edit_delta_check: 87.8 percent of Mikl edits change AU fraction; AU delta sd 0.0197

controls.au_delta_only: single feature, AU fraction of mutant minus AU fraction of parent; both arms must beat it
controls.shuffled_label_null: labels permuted, must stay near chance
controls.random_kmer_projection: 84 random projections of the delta k-mer frequencies, seeded; reproduces the v2/N4 null that previously beat the real feature stack

gates.a3_beats_au_delta: arm A mean auROC exceeds au_delta_only by >= 0.030
gates.a5_seed_stability: standard deviation of arm A mean auROC across seeds <= 0.030
gates.a6_beats_random_kmer: arm A mean auROC exceeds random_kmer_projection by >= 0.020
gates.b1_transfer_correlation: arm B Spearman between predicted and measured effect on mikl_gse173098 >= 0.100 with p < 0.001
gates.b2_transfer_direction: arm B auROC on the Mikl confident subset >= 0.600
gates.b3_beats_au_delta: arm B Spearman exceeds au_delta_only Spearman by >= 0.020
gates.b4_consistent_across_folds: arm B Spearman has the same sign in at least 4 of 5 gene folds
gates.i1_split_integrity: no gene and no group_id appears in both train and test for any scored split

multiplicity: Two primary hypotheses, a1 and b1. Holm correction is applied across them for any reported p-value. No additional arm may be added after scoring.

verdict_rules.development support, STRONG GO still req: all a-gates, all b-gates and both i-gates pass
verdict_rules.PARTIAL GO - RESTRICTED ZERO-SHOT DOMAIN: exactly one arm passes all of its gates, with the restriction named explicitly
verdict_rules.NO-GO - END UNIVERSAL ZERO-SHOT RNADDRES: neither arm passes all of its gates

honest_prior: Arm A has only 1342 labels and Mikl sequence-level reliability is 0.4527, so it is modestly powered. Arm B is a genuine long shot: it asks a composition-sensitive model trained on 10 genes in one assay to carry edit-direction information into another assay and cell type. Both are nevertheless well posed, previously untried, and pre-registered. Failure is an acceptable outcome and must be reported as such.
stopping_rule: v5 is scored exactly once per seed. No gate, threshold, feature set, split, label definition or estimator may change after any score is observed. If both arms fail, v5 closes and no v6 is opened on this data.
preserved_conclusions: FinalShot 98ffc02: NO-GO - END ZERO-SHOT RNADDRESS, unchanged
boundaries_unchanged: quarantined TDP EV5 stability data never accessed
only tests/mechanism_v5, tests/mechanism_v4 and tests/mechanism_v2 are run
